boundary: All preservation, scoring and later score receipts live outside every frozen execution output root. No score, diagnostic, repaired model or extra application interaction has run.

first_pass_preservation.must_follow: Final custody handoff and verified reaping of every owned execution process; preserve all available invalid/partial results too.

score.prerequisite: Root has run the accepted preserver and independently rehashed its complete first-pass manifest.

sequence: Complete/reap all eight execution jobs and hold their receipt inventory.
Run first-pass preserver once at its exclusive original identity.
Root independently authenticates inventory and source/termination metadata without displaying outcomes.
Run saved-forecast scorer once through the stock owned-job wrapper on CPU19.
Reap scorer, authenticate first-pass preservation again, and hash the complete additive score/job/tool-receipt inventory.
Only then display semantic scores and run separately admitted evaluator controls.
